commits.message:
Add cleaned_cyclistic_analysis script for GitHub

This version of the analysis script has been cleaned and streamlined for easier readability and sharing on GitHub. It focuses on modular functions for data cleaning, combines datasets efficiently, and includes summary statistics and visualizations for the Cyclistic Case Study.

Update README.md

Add note about missing cleaned dataset

Upload analysis files for Cyclistic Case Study

Added key project files including:
- cyclistic_analysis.R (full analysis script)
- Final visualizations (PNG files)
- Summary statistics (CSV file)

The cleaned dataset is too large for direct upload and can be reproduced by running the R script.

Update README.md

Updated README with project details.

Upload bellabeat_analysis.R script

Adding main analysis script for the Bellabeat Case Study, including data loading, cleaning, analysis, and visualization steps.

Upload Bellabeat visualizations

Added final visualizations for Bellabeat Case Study, including:
- Distribution of Daily Steps
- Calories Burned vs Steps Taken
- Distribution of Total Minutes Asleep
- Daily Heart Rate Trends

Create visualizations folder with README

Adding a dedicated folder to store all Bellabeat visualizations for better project organization.

Update README for Bellabeat Case Study

Added key project details to the README, including:
- Project overview
- Files list with descriptions
- Important note about large datasets that were too big to upload to GitHub
- Listed both original and combined datasets used in the analysis
- Included explanations for all visualizations

This README provides clear documentation for anyone reviewing the Bellabeat analysis and visualizations.

Create README.md for Bellabeat Case Study

Added project overview, process summary, tools used, key insights, and conclusions for the Bellabeat Case Study. This README serves as documentation for the analysis conducted as part of the Google Data Analytics Capstone. It outlines the steps taken from data loading and cleaning to exploratory analysis and final visualizations, along with key takeaways and recommendations for Bellabeat’s marketing team.
